capabilities: download a course module zip file from a direct URL
unzip downloaded content into a configurable vault folder
skip files that already exist in the target folder
create subfolders matching the zip structure
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.0.0 or newer per the Compatibility section.
motivation: The README says the plugin lets users 'such as course attendees, to easily download and unzip course materials directly into their vault', but no author rationale beyond that.
problem: Course attendees need a way to pull distributed course materials (zip files from direct download links) into their vault without manually downloading and extracting them.
summary: Zip course-module importer that downloads a zip from a URL, unzips it into a chosen vault folder, and skips already existing files.
